title: Decarbonizing Manufacturing Supply Chains: C-Suite Guide | World Economic Forum
text: Amid geopolitical fragmentation, persistent economic headwinds and policy uncertainty, manufacturers and supply chain leaders are operating with tight margins and increasingly complex global footprints. As climate ambition collides with short-term performance pressures, the debate has sharpened: Is decarbonization a competitive advantage or a financial and operational burden?This white paper reframes decarbonization as a value-creation strategy – one that can strengthen operational efficiency and supply chain resilience, reduce exposure to volatility and unlock new revenue through product engineering and business-model innovation. The action needed is to move beyond compliance-driven sustainability efforts towards integrated transformation, aligning operations, finance, procurement, technology and commercial strategy around a clear business case for decarbonization.Drawing on insights from consultations with over 50 industry leaders, academic experts and innovators working across 13 industrial sectors, the paper sets out an executive-level approach to strengthen the business case for industrial decarbonization, anchored in three interconnected outcomes: bottom-line gains, business continuity and resilience, and top-line growth. Supported by real-world case studies of decarbonization solutions, the report aims to help manufacturing executives navigate implementation complexity and translate ambition into actionable strategies with measurable outcomes.Follow this topic.
